facts.fact: The Standards Association of Zimbabwe lists as published in Q1 2026 national standards that are ISO/IEC identicals on information technology, including ZWS ISO/IEC 23894:2023 (AI risk management), 22989:2022 (AI concepts), 27017:2015 (cloud security controls) and 27037:2012 (digital evidence).
